proof_requirements.statement: Show exact bytes written and retrieved under one binding yield the same qualified byte identity.
Show changed, truncated, substituted, or context-mismatched bytes yield typed failure and no success.
Show a write receipt alone cannot satisfy verified readiness.
Show plaintext, unwrapped keys, private keys, and credentials are rejected from writes and evidence.
Show replacement is written and verified before commitment and prior bytes remain recoverable until commitment succeeds.
Show evidence changes identity when adapter, build, provider kind, configuration schema, namespace, endpoint class, locality, binding, or environment changes.
Show one observation cannot establish availability outside its named environment and interval.
Show storage costs remain separate from knowledge consideration in records and outcomes.
Show every consumer semantic slot is exact before a consumer DomainSpec or implementation binding can evaluate.
